caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted clock crafted from wood, predominantly brown in color with varying darker and lighter wood grain patterns. The clock features an ornate top with decorative scrollwork and two small golden finials. Below the scrollwork, there is a round metallic bell that is gray with a central gold detail, situated above the clock face. The clock face is circular, with a yellowish background and black Roman numerals marking the hours, black minute markers forming a ring near the edge, and two black hands. An additional smaller dial is present within the main clock face. The clock case has an open section surrounding the clock face and bell, with curved accents at the corners. The lower part of the clock consists of an enclosed rectangular wooden compartment with a slightly protruding ledge and additional paneling, matching the wood finish of the upper section. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light-beige background, and the artist’s name “ULRICH FISCHER” is written in small letters in the lower-left corner.
title: Wall Clock
